single_changed_variable: replace the invalid continuous-caption marker outcome with a prospective bounded stimulus-response target and two-human reliability protocol without changing model or data
post_freeze_rule: Do not change labels, blinding, alpha threshold, human count or scoring after any new target content is viewed. A revision must preserve this version and use a separately frozen prospective pilot.
claim_boundary: The implementation freeze proves only that the protocol was bound before new evidence. It does not make synthetic tests human reliability or establish a model effect.
